The ward reads admitted at WARD-C, v3, epoch 14, and its history (v1 admit, v2 update, v3 transfer WARD-C) holds no discharge. The timeline shows no later events. The route was read (HTTP 200) and supports conditional writes, receipts, dry runs and history. Effect of a resend: one bounded movement, v3 to v4, conditional on expected_version 3. Under the contract, discharge is allowed from admitted. If the version has moved, the write fails safely. Shutter can check the receipt and history afterwards (DEP-3.1). Downstream effects (bed board frees the bed, pharmacy stops, EPR shows discharged) follow from the ward record but cannot be checked from here (DEP-1.1). Reconcile does not fit because no receipt shows the discharge in effect. Doing nothing leaves the patient shown as occupying a WARD-C bed with pharmacy still active, which is inferred harm until the discharge is applied. Superseded does not apply because no later applied event exists. The earlier failed transfer to WARD-B (MSG01109) was overtaken by the applied v3 transfer to WARD-C. That matches catalogue E5, whose preferred outcome is resend_latest. The other operation is out of scope for this case.
